abstract: The Consumer Technology Association (CTA)’s contributions to the worldwide library of video standards this past year included documents addressing NEXTGEN TV, streaming video, closed captioning, and augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR).

authors.bio: Dave Wilson is the vice president of Technology and Standards at the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), Arlington, VA. He and his team manage numerous groups of industry volunteers who develop consumer technology standards on a wide range of topics. CTA is actively working on the standards for streaming video, TV energy consumption, augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR), health, fitness and wellness technology, artificial intelligence, consumer device networks, audio systems, and other topics. CTA’s standards program is accredited by the American National Standards Institute and has over 1200 participants.
